role: Posthoc ordinary tool-based edit control, not a new Agent method or matched inference-budget claim
sources: The same A/B original checkpoints used by both paired model conditions; never start from their results
assets_and_shell: Keep all instances, real assets, dimensions, shell, heights and rotations unchanged
trigger: Run only when the existing complete finite-pool joint check has no witness. A task allowing reuse does not require a joint witness; still report both scopes.
candidate_object_rule: Every placed object appearing in a measured surface blocker list, sorted by exact object ID; no manually named target
candidate_rule: All nonzero Cartesian XY offsets for one candidate object at a time; exhaustive fixed list; no additional rounds or parameter retuning
acceptance: Joint planar witness under the existing tool; no new furniture intersection pair; no new wall/door/window intersection pair; no newly out-of-bounds object; all required instances retained. These conditions do not establish complete human use.
selection: Among acceptable candidates minimize furniture intersection count, then Euclidean displacement, then object ID and offsets
execution: Re-execute at most one selected edit via the identical native move tool, export full room, rerun frozen mesh and joint checks. Save all rejected candidates. If no candidate qualifies retain original state.
budget: No model, API, training or new asset. Report all local candidate and execution time; costs not equated with one model call. Supports ordinary search as a necessary control, not a general search optimum.
